business_problem: Accenture needed enterprise-wide AI governance and consistent support workflows for roughly 800,000 employees and 1,900 business services as AI usage expanded across the company.
solution_summary: Accenture needed enterprise-wide AI governance and consistent support workflows for roughly 800,000 employees and 1,900 business services as AI usage expanded across the company. Accenture implemented a ServiceNow-centered stack built around ServiceNow AI Platform, AI Control Tower, ServiceNow Otto, and Virtual Agent. Key components included ServiceNow AI Platform provides the common workflow and AI layer; AI Control Tower governs AI inventory and ROI; ServiceNow Otto acts as an internal AI assistant under central governance; Virtual Agent handles conversational self-service. Requests enter through Virtual Agent before ServiceNow AI Platform, AI Control Tower, and ServiceNow Otto routes or fulfills the work. The same record of work is then exposed back to agents and end users through the platform. Running AI governance and compliance operations on one data model reduced manual handoffs and made expansion easier.
